snp5.19:1.1: "Pārāyanam anugāyissaṃ:* icc-āyasmā Piṅgiyo yathā addakkhi, tathā akkhāsi vimalo bhūrimedhaso, nikkāmo nibbano nātho kissa hetu musā bhaṇe. || ||
snp5.19:2.1: Pahīnamalamohassa mānamakkhappahāyino handāhaṃ kittayissāmi giraṃ vaṇṇūpasaṃhitaṃ. || ||
snp5.19:3.1: Tamonudo Buddho samantacakkhu lokantagū sabbabhavātivatto anāsavo sabbadukkhappahīno saccavhayo brahme upāsito me. || ||
snp5.19:4.1: Dijo yathā kubbanakaṃ pahāya bahupphalaṃ kānanaṃ āvaseyya, evam p' ahaṃ appadasse pahāya mahodadhiṃ haṃsa-r-iv' ajjhapatto. || ||
snp5.19:5.1: Ye 'me pubbe viyākaṃsu huraṃ Gotamasāsanā: ‘icc-āsi, iti bhavissati,' sabban taṃ itihītihaṃ, sabban taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ. || ||
snp5.19:6.1: Eko tamanud' āsīno jātimā so pabhaṃkaro Gotamo bhūripaññāṇo, Gotamo bhūrimedhaso, || ||
snp5.19:7.1: yo me dhammam adesesi sandiṭṭhikam akālikaṃ taṇhakkhayam anītikaṃ, yassa n' atthi upamā kvaci". || ||
snp5.19:8.1: "Kin nu tamhā vippavasasi muhuttam api Piṅgiya Gotamā bhūripaññāṇā, Gotamā bhūrimedhasā, || ||
snp5.19:9.1: yo te dhammam adesesi sandiṭṭhikam akālikaṃ taṇhakkhayam anītikaṃ, yassa n' atthi upamā kvaci". || ||
snp5.19:10.1: "Nāhaṃ tamhā vippavasāmi muhuttam api brāhmaṇa Gotamā bhūripaññāṇā, Gotamā bhūrimedhasā, || ||
snp5.19:11.1: yo me dhammam adesesi sandiṭṭhikam akālikaṃ taṇhakkhayam anītikaṃ, yassa n' atthi upamā kvaci. || ||
snp5.19:12.1: Passāmi naṃ manasā cakkhunā va rattindivaṃ brāhmaṇa appamatto, namassamāno vivasemi rattiṃ, ten' eva maññāmi avippavāsaṃ. || ||
snp5.19:13.1: Saddhā ca pītī ca mano satī ca nāpenti me Gotamasāsanamhā, yaṃ yaṃ disaṃ vajati bhūripañño, sa tena ten' eva nato 'ham asmi. || ||
snp5.19:14.1: Jiṇṇassa me dubbalathāmakassa ten' eva kāyo na paleti tattha, saṃkappayattāya vajāmi niccaṃ, mano hi me brāhmaṇa tena yutto. || ||
snp5.19:15.1: Paṃke sayāno pariphandamāno dīpā dīpaṃ uppalaviṃ, ath' addasāsiṃ Sambuddhaṃ oghatiṇṇam anāsavaṃ". || ||
snp5.19:16.1: "Yathā ahū Vakkali muttasaddho Bhadrāvudho Āḷavi-Gotamo ca, evam eva tvam pi pamuñcassu saddhaṃ: gamissasi tvaṃ Piṅgiya maccudheyyapāraṃ". || ||
snp5.19:17.1: "Esa bhiyyo pasīdāmi sutvāna munino vaco: vivattacchaddo Sambuddho akhilo paṭibhānavā || ||
snp5.19:18.1: adhideve abhiññāya sabbaṃ vedi parovaraṃ, pañhān' antakaro Satthā kaṃkhīnaṃ paṭijānataṃ. || ||
snp5.19:19.1: Asaṃhīraṃ asaṃkuppaṃ, yassa n' atthi upamā kvaci, addhā gamissāmi, na m' ettha kaṃkhā, evaṃ maṃ dhārehi adhimuttacittan" ti || || PĀRĀYANAVAGGO NIṬṬHITO. NIṬṬHITO SUTTANIPĀTO
